title: Flags, Grids, Indents, Reticles & Chips
description: Five live drops: pure-CSS pixel sprite marching, a three-engine drag-reorder photo grid, native hanging-indent typography, a magnetic bracket cursor, and a keyboard-first chip combobox.

drops.title: Pixel March
drops.description: Zero-JS pixel sprites that walk forever, driven entirely by CSS steps() keyframes swapping SVG frames.
drops.concept: Three retro pixel sprites (invader, ghost, bot) each loop a two-frame walk cycle via CSS @keyframes with steps(1,end) timing, while a separate translateX keyframe carries the whole row across the screen — no JavaScript animates any frame, only percentage stops.

interaction.mouse: Adjust march speed, pixel scale, and palette in the debug panel
interaction.click: Palette swatches recolor all sprites instantly
interaction.touch: Panel hidden on small screens; sprites still march automatically

drops.title: Tessellate Mini
drops.description: One photo set, three layout engines — justified, masonry, and fixed-ratio — plus drag-to-reorder with FLIP reflow.
drops.concept: A dozen synthetic gradient tiles can be arranged by a greedy justified-row packer, a shortest-column masonry algorithm, or a fixed-ratio grid, all computed live in JS and positioned with absolute layout. Dragging a tile onto another swaps their order and the whole grid animates to its new positions using the FLIP technique.

interaction.mouse: Drag any tile onto another to swap positions
interaction.click: Switch layout mode or adjust density/gap in the panel
interaction.touch: Drag works with touch via Pointer Events

drops.title: Hanging Indent Editorial
drops.description: The newly-Baseline text-indent: hanging / each-line keywords, shown across a bibliography, a stanza, and a pull-quote.
drops.concept: text-indent gained hanging and each-line keywords that reached Baseline widely-available in March 2026 — real hanging-indent and per-hard-break-indent typography with no negative-margin hacks. Three live samples (bibliography, poem stanza, hanging-punctuation pull-quote) share one set of controls.
drops.source: Inspired by the CSS text-indent specification (MDN)

interaction.mouse: Drag sliders to change indent size and font size
interaction.click: Toggle the hanging / each-line / hanging-punctuation checkboxes
interaction.touch: All controls are touch-friendly range inputs and checkboxes

drops.title: Bracket Cursor
drops.description: A magnetic reticle whose four corner brackets snap around whatever you hover, like a camera focus ring.
drops.concept: Four independent corner-bracket elements are repositioned as a group using a single translate + width/height transition. On hover of any [data-cursor] target, the reticle tweens to that element's padded bounding box; otherwise it follows the raw cursor as a small crosshair. Desktop-only by design, matching the source component's intent.

interaction.mouse: Move over any button, card, or link to see the brackets snap to it
interaction.click: Adjust padding, corner size, and snap speed in the panel
interaction.touch: Effect is skipped on touch devices; a note explains why

drops.title: Chip Combobox
drops.description: A keyboard-first multi-select: fuzzy-filter grouped options, arrow through results, manage picks as chips.
drops.concept: Three independent multi-select instances (tech stack, team members, tags) each support subsequence fuzzy matching with match-character highlighting, grouped dropdown sections, full arrow-key/Enter/Escape/Backspace keyboard flow, and removable chips rendered inline with the input.

interaction.mouse: Click the field to open the list, click an option to select it
interaction.click: Click a chip's × to remove it
interaction.touch: Fully usable with the on-screen keyboard
